config.craftraria.title: Craftraria Settings
config.craftraria.category.browser.descr: The embedded Chromium browser that runs the game.
config.craftraria.category.craftraria.de: How Craftraria presents Terraria over Minecraft.
craftraria.notice.resolutionChanged: Screen resolution changed. Reload page to apply.
config.craftraria.windowMode.tooltip: Changes apply the next time the Terraria window opens.
config.craftraria.backgroundBlur.tooltip: Whether the background behind the window is blurred.
config.craftraria.aspectLocked.tooltip: Locks browser window aspect ratio when you resize it. Holding shift during a drag will override this setting.
config.craftraria.gameContent: Your own Terraria Content directory is staged and served locally; the mod never ships Re-Logic assets.
config.craftraria.runtime: Terraria runs through the Terrarium wasm build (MercuryWorkshop/terraria-wasm, release 1.0). Frame timing, shaders and audio are the port's, so frame-identical parity is not guaranteed, but the game logic is the genuine one.
config.craftraria.openToggle.tooltip: Turn this off if you need the open key to function in the browser. Otherwise, this shouldn't need to be touched.
config.craftraria.renderScale.tooltip: The game picks this up when the page loads: change it, then reload the page. Below 100 renders faster and looks softer. Above 100 renders sharper than the window, capped at the window's own full-screen size.
config.craftraria.frameRate.tooltip: Essentially, the max FPS of the browser. Caps out at Minecraft's FPS.
config.craftraria.statsOverlay.tooltip: Shows stats for nerds and debugging in the corner of the Terraria window.
